title: Food, Gut, Fasting & Self-Denial in the Geometry of Living Systems
subtitle: Nutrition and Caloric Restriction as Thermodynamic Shifts and Markov-Blanket Reconfiguration

blocks.explanation: Nutrition and caloric restriction are treated as macroscopic thermodynamic shifts and topological reconfigurations of the Markov blanket. The gut-brain axis is a bidirectional information manifold; the endocrinology of satiety and hunger (ghrelin, leptin, GLP-1, PYY, CCK) sets the hormonal attractor landscape, with hyper-palatable Western diets a thermodynamic trap. Intermittent fasting drives a metabolic switch to fatty-acid oxidation and ketogenesis, cellular metric optimization via autophagy, and microbiome remodeling. Satiety and voluntary self-denial appear as the ultimate test of hierarchical active inference — top-down control overriding low-level homeostatic drives to optimize long-term systemic architecture.
blocks.tts: Food, gut, and fasting as thermodynamic reconfiguration: the gut-brain axis, satiety hormones, the fasting metabolic switch, and self-denial as top-down active inference.
